latest.title: Investor who called for AI pivot in 2023 says bitcoin is going to $57,000
latest.description: Jason Calacanis wants investors to sell bitcoin and back artificial intelligence. He is also holding TAO, the cryptocurrency behind AI network Bittensor.

latest.title: GM will switch to Nasdaq from the NYSE on Nov. 17
latest.description: GM expects to keep its “GM” ticker symbol, and the company says shareholders do not need to take action because of the transfer.

latest.title: Oil prices seesaw amid renewed diplomatic efforts to end Mideast conflict
latest.description: Renewed diplomatic efforts to end the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran pushed oil prices lower

latest.title: Man charged with assisting ‘foreign intelligence service’ after incident at UK base used for Iran strikes
latest.description: Two men face U.K. national security charges after an incident at a British air base used by U.S. forces during strikes on Iran.

latest.title: CRE debt is due, presenting a 'massive' opportunity
latest.description: A massive wall of commercial real estate debt is coming due now and over the next two years. For some, this presents an opportunity.

latest.title: UPS beats quarterly expectations, raises full-year guidance again
latest.description: UPS beat Wall Street expectations for its third-quarter results and raised its full-year guidance for the second quarter in a row.

latest.title: Melania Trump-brokered local ceasefire begins as Russia continues attacks on Ukraine
latest.description: An Oleshky ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump began Tuesday as Russia launched missiles and drones at cities across Ukraine.

latest.title: Ripple Wins Final OCC Approval for Trust Bank Behind $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin
latest.description: The federally supervised bank will manage RLUSD's reserves and offer custody, as banking groups fight crypto charters in court.

latest.title: Porsche profit rebounds as luxury carmaker reduces exposure to China
latest.description: Luxury German carmaker Porsche said it's rapidly reducing its exposure to the Chinese autos market after reporting a profit recovery in the first nine months.

latest.title: Zcash co-founder calls to stop funding ‘over $125M’ grants program
latest.description: Sean Bowe says ZCG has enough money to keep funding projects and wants its share of new ZEC redirected to a reserve for the network.

latest.title: Silicon Valley AI political groups turn on each other in the 2026 election
latest.description: AI political groups are spending millions in the 2026 election as Silicon Valley factions battle over regulation, safeguards and state authority.

latest.title: Now is the time to accumulate bitcoin, Galaxy says
latest.description: Galaxy argues improving price trends, resilient ETF demand and rising U.S. debt support bitcoin’s recovery towards its previous high.

latest.title: Nvidia to invest $3 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
latest.description: Meta on Monday announced plans to raise a total of $95 billion to support its investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure.

latest.title: Bloom bot hackers loot $953K faster than you can microwave popcorn
latest.description: Bloom pledged to reimburse nine traders after $953,000 was drained from 48 wallets, saying no private keys were accessed or compromised.

latest.title: HSBC shares slump on revenue miss, lender announces share buyback of up to $1 billion
latest.description: HSBC announced its third-quarter earnings on Tuesday.

latest.title: An AI label alone no longer wins lenders, JPMorgan says
latest.description: As default insurance on several AI-linked firms hits record costs, companies must show they can finance investment, service the debt and eventually mint cash, JPMorgan says.

latest.title: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline
latest.description: The exchange is delisting 22 crypto assets for Brazilian users and hopes talks with the central bank will allow it to restore some services.

latest.title: Solana bug reports now cost 1 SOL as AI floods security teams with spam
latest.description: Researchers must now permanently burn 1 SOL for every submission after a monthlong contest drew 809 reports, with AI believed to have helped generate or write nearly all of them.

latest.title: Bitcoin ETFs claw back $110M after $774M exit
latest.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs remained in the red for October, with about $202 million in net outflows for the month despite Monday’s rebound.
